    "The union between Princess Märtha Louise of Norway, the intuitive offspring of one of Europe’s most enduring monarchs, and Durek Verrett, a self-proclaimed sixth-generation shaman from California, was anything but a typical royal wedding. Despite its unconventional nature, crowds gathered along the rain-soaked streets of Geiranger on Saturday, eager to witness the bride’s arrival.",
    "As the sole daughter of King Harald and Queen Sonja, 52-year-old Märtha Louise holds the fourth position in Norway’s line of succession. She exchanged vows with 49-year-old Verrett in a traditional Norwegian church ceremony, held at the four-star Hotel Union in a picturesque village nestled beneath the Geiranger fjord.",
    "The princess was accompanied by seven bridesmaids, including her teenage daughters, Leah and Emma Behn, from her previous marriage to the late Norwegian writer Ari Behn, whom she divorced in 2017. Among the 350 guests were notable figures such as Märtha Louise’s brother, Crown Prince Haakon, and his wife, Crown Princess Mette-Marit, as well as Sweden’s Crown Princess Victoria and Prince Daniel, and Prince Constantijn and Princess Laurentien of the Netherlands.",
    "Princess Märtha Louise has long defied royal conventions, having previously identified as a clairvoyant and spent ten years operating a spiritual school where she instructed others on connecting with angels. In 2022, she announced her decision to withdraw from official royal engagements to concentrate on her and Verrett’s business ventures, aiming to create a clearer separation between their work and the Norwegian royal family.",
    "Verrett, who refers to himself on Instagram as a 'servant of God' and an 'energy activator,' counts high-profile clients among his followers, including Goop founder Gwyneth Paltrow, whom he has described as a 'soul sister.'"
